# Atlantis Press

> > Atlantis Press is an open access STM publisher, part of Springer Nature, offering journals, conference proceedings, and academic books with indexing in DOAJ, Google Scholar, and CNKI.

Atlantis Press operates from offices in Dordrecht and Paris, adhering to COPE ethics guidelines and TOP (Transparency and Openness Promotion) standards. The publisher provides comprehensive services for authors, editors, and conference organizers across scientific, technical, and medical disciplines.

## Core Publications

- [Journals](https://www.atlantis-press.com/journals): Open access journals portfolio indexed in DOAJ and following COPE ethics
- [Proceedings](https://www.atlantis-press.com/proceedings): Conference proceedings series indexed in Google Scholar and Dimensions
- [Premium Proceedings](https://www.atlantis-press.com/premium-proceedings): Premium conference proceedings with enhanced indexing and DOI services
- [Books](https://www.atlantis-press.com/books): Academic book series co-published with Springer Nature on SpringerLink

## Author Services

- [Publish with Us](https://www.atlantis-press.com/publish): Author services for publishing journals, proceedings, and books

## About & Contact

- [About Atlantis Press](https://www.atlantis-press.com/about): STM open access publisher profile, part of Springer Nature group
- [Contact](https://www.atlantis-press.com/contact): Contact information and office locations in Dordrecht and Paris
